data.one_liner: Render dotLottie and Lottie animations with state machines and playback controls.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for rendering Lottie and dotLottie animations across iOS, Android, macOS, Web, Windows, and Linux. It provides playback control, state machine support, theming, and slot manipulation.
use_when: You need to render dotLottie or Lottie animations in your Flutter application.
You require interactive state machines or playback controls like seeking and speed changes.
You need cross-platform animation support including mobile, desktop, and web.
avoid_when: You only need simple vector asset rendering without playback states or Lottie features.
Your target environment does not support native platform views or FFI bindings.
strengths: Full playback control and cross-platform support (iOS, Android, macOS, Web, Windows, Linux).
Advanced features like state machines, audio volume control, and dynamic slots.
Built on native implementations and rust via FFI for performance.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup on Android (jitpack repository configuration).
Some advanced features like external assets have platform limitations.
data.setup_notes: Android requires adding jitpack to your build.gradle.kts file. Windows and Linux include pre-built binaries automatically.
data.minimal_example:
DotLottieView(
  sourceType: 'url',
  source: 'https://lottie.host/your-animation.lottie',
  autoplay: true,
  loop: true,
)
